prompt: Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. The scene only contains the described setup and actions. On top of the acrylic sheet was placed a small dollop of red paint. The paintbrush is attached to the black platform sitting next to the clear acrylic sheet with red paint on it on a wooden table. The paintbrush rotates clockwise on the black platform, passes through the dollop of red paint on the clear acrylic sheet, and moves past the dollop of red paint.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
S=4
W,H=256,144
source=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# Reconstruct only the surfaces previously occluded by the movable apparatus.
mask=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
cv2.fillPoly(mask,[np.array([(143,51),(160,49),(224,42),(249,40),(251,45),(224,47),(160,55),(143,57)])],255)
cv2.line(mask,(143,58),(202,82),255,5)
cv2.fillPoly(mask,[np.array([(212,44),(256,40),(256,57),(250,58),(248,66),(232,67),(231,63),(220,62),(220,55),(213,54)])],255)
base=cv2.inpaint(source,mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(float)
yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
co=(xx-278)/61
upper=65+4*co-17*np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-co*co))
platform=(np.abs(co)<1)&(yy>=upper)&(yy<75)
# Match the visible matte, charcoal top of the circular turntable.
shade=1.1*(yy-60)/15-0.04*(xx-243)
for c,v in enumerate([26,32,34]):
 col=v+shade
 sel=platform&(mask>0)
 base[:,:,c][sel]=col[sel]
base=np.uint8(np.clip(base,0,255))

plane=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(np.float32([[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]),np.float32([[13,85],[178,137],[216,31],[116,20]]))
inv=np.linalg.inv(plane)
def world(p):
 a=inv@np.r_[p,1.];return a[:2]/a[2]
def screen(p):
 a=plane@np.r_[p,1.];return a[:2]/a[2]
center=world((273,78))
def move(p,angle,z=0):
 q=world((p[0],p[1]+z))-center
 c,s=np.cos(angle),np.sin(angle)
 q=np.array([c*q[0]-s*q[1],s*q[0]+c*q[1]])+center
 r=screen(q);r[1]-=z
 return r

def polygon_mask(points):
 im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0);d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 d.polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
 return np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.48))) /255.

src_hi=cv2.resize(source,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)
shaftmask=polygon_mask([(138.2,53.1),(141,52.4),(158,50),(247.8,40.6),(248.4,43.8),(159,53.6),(143,55.6),(139.2,55.7)])
mountmask=polygon_mask([(213.1,46.2),(224.8,44.9),(225,43.5),(235,42.7),(245.8,41.6),(248.3,43.4),(253.7,43.6),(256,44),(256,52.8),(249.1,53),(248,56.5),(245,56.5),(245.3,65.4),(235.1,63.9),(234.5,55.1),(232.4,56.6),(231.7,61.2),(222.4,59.9),(221.8,55.5),(223,51.9),(213.1,52.5)])
# Do not copy the stationary paint deposit into the brush sprite.
shaft_quad=np.float32([[138,50],[250,39],[251,47],[138,59]])
mount_quad=np.float32([[211,40],[260,40],[260,68],[211,68]])

def transform_sprite(alpha,quad,angle,height):
 target=np.float32([move(p,angle,height(p)) for p in quad])*S
 mat=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(quad*S,target)
 prem=src_hi*alpha[:,:,None]
 rgb=cv2.warpPerspective(prem,mat,(W*S,H*S),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
 a=cv2.warpPerspective(alpha.astype(np.float32),mat,(W*S,H*S),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
 return rgb,a

def over(bg,rgb,a):
 return bg*(1-a[:,:,None])+rgb

def paint_trace(frame,angle):
 # Viscous paint is drawn out of the dollop, leaving a tapering wet arc.
 tmax=min(abs(angle),.258)
 if tmax<.001:return frame
 im=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S),(0,0,0,0));d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 ts=np.linspace(0,tmax,max(5,int(tmax*400)))
 pts=[move((139.5,54.3),-t,0) for t in ts]
 for k in range(len(ts)-1):
  t=(ts[k]+ts[k+1])*.5
  amount=max(0,1-t/.258)
  radius=.22+1.53*amount**1.7
  col=(166+int(15*amount),34+int(5*amount),23, int(200+30*amount))
  p=pts[k];q=pts[k+1]
  d.line([tuple(p*S),tuple(q*S)],fill=col,width=max(1,round(2*radius*S)))
  d.ellipse(((q[0]-radius)*S,(q[1]-radius*.8)*S,(q[0]+radius)*S,(q[1]+radius*.8)*S),fill=col)
 # A soft bright ridge records the wet, uneven paint surface.
 for k in range(1,len(ts)-1):
  if ts[k]>.15:break
  p,q=pts[k],pts[k+1]
  d.line([(p[0]*S-.35*S,p[1]*S-.4*S),(q[0]*S-.35*S,q[1]*S-.4*S)],fill=(211,63,43,75),width=2)
 arr=np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.46))).astype(float)
 a=arr[:,:,3]/255
 return over(frame,arr[:,:,:3]*a[:,:,None],a)

frames=[source.copy()]
for i in range(1,20):
 # Slow constant-speed clockwise movement; the brush stays on the sheet.
 angle=-np.deg2rad(32)*i/19
 frame=cv2.resize(base,(W*S,H*S),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(float)
 frame=paint_trace(frame,angle)
 # Shadow cast by the slender shaft, displaced by the overhead illumination.
 sm=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0);d=ImageDraw.Draw(sm)
 shadowpts=[]
 for f in np.linspace(0,1,35):
  p=np.array([140.0,54.8])*(1-f)+np.array([246.7,43.0])*f
  z=28*f
  q=move(p,angle,z)
  q+=np.array([-.95,.98])*z
  shadowpts.append(tuple(q*S))
 d.line(shadowpts,fill=45,width=round(2*S))
 a=np.asarray(sm.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1.4*S))).astype(float)/255
 # Cast shadow falls on the acrylic rather than crossing the turntable.
 frame*=1-a[:,:,None]*.64
 # Wooden attachment and folded green tape rotate with the shaft.
 rgb,a=transform_sprite(mountmask,mount_quad,angle,lambda p:73-p[1]+.11*(p[0]-235))
 frame=over(frame,rgb,a)
 rgb,a=transform_sprite(shaftmask,shaft_quad,angle,lambda p:np.clip((p[0]-139)/109,0,1)*29)
 frame=over(frame,rgb,a)
 # Loaded red bristles, still wet after leaving the small paint mound.
 tip=move((139.8,54.4),angle,0)
 back=move((143.5,53.9),angle,(143.5-139)/109*29)
 b=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S),(0,0,0,0));bd=ImageDraw.Draw(b)
 direction=back-tip;normal=np.array([-direction[1],direction[0]]);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
 points=[tip-normal*.65,tip+normal*.7,back+normal*.65,back-normal*.6]
 bd.polygon([tuple(p*S) for p in points],fill=(174,48,25,230))
 bd.line([tuple((tip-normal*.2)*S),tuple((back-normal*.2)*S)],fill=(213,79,43,180),width=1)
 ar=np.asarray(b.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.48))).astype(float);a=ar[:,:,3]/255
 frame=over(frame,ar[:,:,:3]*a[:,:,None],a)
 frame=cv2.resize(np.uint8(np.clip(frame,0,255)),(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
 frames.append(frame)
frames=np.array(frames,np.uint8)
save(frames,ROOT)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))
